full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph captures several cyclists moving along a broad old city street beside a small dark car. The street runs into the distance at the left, lined with tall multi-story facades on the right and a dense canopy of trees on the left. Near the center foreground, a man in a dark suit, tie, and brimmed hat rides a bicycle toward the camera, hands steady on the handlebars. A round front lamp and thin wheel are clearly visible beneath him. Just behind, other men on bicycles follow in a loose line, their faces and hats gradually becoming smaller and less distinct. A small enclosed car is parked or moving close beside the leading cyclist at the right, its dark body and bright windows forming a compact block against the paler road. Pedestrians occupy the far sidewalk and middle distance, adding activity without a single dominant gesture. The road surface is matte and lightly mottled, with the curb creating a long diagonal toward the background. Buildings repeat windows, balconies, and cornice lines across the upper right; leaves make the upper left darker and more irregular. Soft overcast daylight spreads evenly across the scene, producing moderate shadows under hats, bicycles, and cars rather than harsh contrast. Fine film grain and a little motion softness appear in the distant figures, while the leading rider and vehicle remain fairly clear. The overall composition turns an ordinary passing moment into a layered rhythm of wheels, faces, and urban lines.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白街头照片捕捉几名骑车人沿宽阔旧城街道行进，旁边有一辆小型深色汽车。街道向左侧远处延伸，右边是一排高大的多层立面，左边有浓密树冠。中央前景附近，一名穿深色西装、打领带、戴有檐帽的男子骑车朝镜头而来，双手稳稳扶着车把。圆形前灯和细车轮在身下清楚可见。其后几名男子骑车松散跟随，面容和帽子逐渐变小、变模糊。一辆小型封闭汽车停在或驶在领骑者右边不远，深色车身和明亮车窗在较浅路面前形成紧凑色块。行人占据远处人行道和中景，增添活动，却没有单一主导动作。路面哑光且轻微斑驳，路缘形成通向背景的长斜线。建筑的窗户、阳台和檐口线在右上方重复；树叶让左上方更深且不规则。柔和阴天日光均匀铺过场景，在帽檐、自行车和汽车下形成适度阴影，而非强烈反差。远处人物带细微胶片颗粒和少许运动柔化，领骑者与车辆仍相当清楚。整体构图把普通经过的瞬间化为车轮、面孔和城市线条的层叠节奏。
style_prompt_en: The image has a candid black-and-white street-photography finish, with fine film grain and a deep, naturally layered scene. Charcoal figures and vehicles stand against silver-gray pavement and facades, while darker irregular canopy shapes balance the upper field. Overcast daylight is broad and forgiving, keeping midtone detail in clothing and built surfaces. The focal foreground is relatively crisp, with increasing softness and smaller scale toward the distance. Repeated linear edges and circular accents give motion a visual rhythm without staged symmetry. A diagonal ground line pulls the eye through the crowd, and the overall effect is observant, lively, and gently nostalgic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有抓拍式黑白街头摄影质感，带细微胶片颗粒和自然层叠的深场景。炭色人物与物件立在银灰铺地及立面前，较深的不规则树冠形状平衡上部。阴天日光宽泛而温和，让衣物和建成表面保持中间调细节。焦点前景相对清楚，向远处逐渐变软、尺度缩小。重复线性边缘与圆形强调给予运动视觉节奏，却无摆拍式对称。一道斜向地面线引导目光穿过人群，整体效果善于观察、活泼且轻带怀旧。
theme_en: Cyclists moving along a busy old city street beside a small car
theme_zh: 小汽车旁骑车穿过旧城繁忙街道的人们
name: Robert Doisneau
